source_name: NCR Atleos - corporate site and newsroom
why_relevant: The other half of the ATM hardware duopoly. CZ exposure surfaced indirectly via the Travelex 600-ATM refresh which explicitly includes Czech Republic locations; also the vehicle for ATM-as-a-Service outsourcing pitches that CZ banks are the target market for.

source_name: Protext (CTK PR wire) - vendor/processor press releases
why_relevant: The Czech news agency's paid PR wire is where CZ payment vendors publish contract wins that never make editorial coverage - e.g. Global Payments Europe's new contract with Komercni banka, and Euronet ATM statements. Full-text searchable archive of vendor claims, in Czech.

source_name: Nexi Central Europe
why_relevant: Nexi's CEE hub describes itself as a competence centre for ATM and POS terminal management and transaction switching covering the Czech Republic, doing full issuing and acquiring processing for major banking groups. Identifies an alternative processing stack competing with Global Payments Europe in CZ.

source_name: Monet+ a.s. - payments / card personalisation portfolio
why_relevant: Czech-owned supplier of chip-card production and personalisation, PIN handling and digital-certificate security to banks. A domestic vendor whose product pages map the physical card issuance supply chain in CZ - a segment with almost no public statistics.

source_name: BANIT (Bankovni informacni technologie, s.r.o.) - CSOB terminal & ATM arm
why_relevant: 100% CSOB subsidiary that builds and operates the card, terminal, ATM and payment-gateway infrastructure, including full or partial ATM outsourcing (delivery, installation, monitoring, service). A rare public window into how a large CZ bank structures its self-service estate, and a named customer of Asseco.

source_name: Temenos - press releases and success stories
why_relevant: Documents the largest CZ core-banking replacement on record: Komercni banka live on Temenos Transact (Temenos Core + Data Hub since 2021), first phase in under 12 months with implementation partner Syncordis, phased retail migration targeted for completion end-2025. Names both the platform vendor and the SI - information KB itself discloses only in fragments.

source_name: Asseco Central Europe - Czech references page
why_relevant: An explicit customer-reference enumeration in Czech, listing banking clients including BANIT, CSOB and CSOB Penzijni fond Progress alongside the Core Banking System product page. Exactly the pointer-type page the cell is built around: it maps institution -> platform.

source_name: Cleverlance / Aricoma Group (KKCG) - banking client base
why_relevant: Largest domestic IT integrator group (Cleverlance under Aricoma/KKCG) supplying systems to Komercni banka, Creditas and others, with published revenue figures. Domestic SIs are the delivery layer beneath foreign platform vendors, and their client lists reveal which CZ banks are mid-transformation.

source_name: Dotykacka / Dotypay - Czech POS & SoftPOS vendor
why_relevant: Domestic Android-terminal and SoftPOS vendor operating largely on a rental model and a named delivery partner in the state-supported 'Cesko plati kartou' terminal-subsidy scheme - a direct driver of POS penetration among CZ micro-merchants.

source_name: CSOB 'Platba kartou' merchant terminal catalogue
why_relevant: A bank-run merchant-facing catalogue that names the exact hardware models in the estate (Ingenico ICT220/IWL220/Desk 3200, Verifone VX520/VX675/VX680, SoftPOS). Model catalogues and user manuals are the most reliable open evidence of which terminal OEM supplies which CZ acquirer.

source_name: E-ZAK CNB - Czech National Bank e-procurement portal
why_relevant: Public-sector counterpart to vendor marketing: tender documents and award notices disclose named suppliers, specifications and contract values for cash-handling and payment technology at the central bank. Where private banks disclose nothing, procurement filings give hard, dated, priced vendor relationships.

source_name: Printec Group - ATM software & solutions (CEE vendor)
why_relevant: Regional CEE self-service integrator whose solution and customer pages indicate competitive positioning in the same CZ/CEE self-service segment as DN and NCR Atleos. Useful as a competitive-landscape reference even where a specific CZ customer is not named publicly.

source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (VVZ) – national public procurement bulletin
why_relevant: Mandatory national publication point for contract notices and contract award notices above thresholds under Act 134/2016 Sb. Notices for payment terminal operation, card acquiring, ATM services and cash logistics carry estimated/awarded values, quantities, durations and the winning supplier – hard numbers on volumes and incumbents that are otherwise unpublished in a private banking market. Confirmed example seen in search: 'Realizace provozu platebních terminálů pro CS ČR 2017' (Customs Administration), evidence no. Z2017-017645.

source_name: ISVZ – Informační systém o veřejných zakázkách (statistics, dashboards, open data)
why_relevant: The analytical layer over VVZ: interactive dashboards, static reports on the Czech public procurement market and OpenData datasets plus classifier lists (CPV). Lets the whole tender corpus be filtered by CPV to quantify how much the state spends on payment acceptance, ATM and cash-handling services and which suppliers win.

source_name: NEN – Národní elektronický nástroj (National Electronic Tool)
why_relevant: State e-procurement platform used by ministries, state enterprises and sectoral contracting authorities; full tender documentation (technical specifications, quantities, service levels) is downloadable without registration for many contracts. Confirmed relevant example found: 'Poskytování bezpečnostních služeb chráněné pozemní přepravy hotovosti a cenin a zpracování hotovosti II.' (N006-20-V00030707) – cash-in-transit and cash-processing services with dates and scope.

source_name: Věstník NEN
why_relevant: Chronological notice feed inside NEN – a convenient monitoring surface for newly published notices before they are indexed elsewhere.

source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU supplement, Czechia notices)
source_subtype: EU official journal supplement / open data
why_relevant: All above-threshold Czech notices are duplicated to TED in structured form, including contract award notices with awarded value and supplier. TED is the best machine-readable route to Czech payment/cash tenders (e.g. notice 420945-2019, Czechia-Prague, financial transaction processing and clearing-house services; Czech Post notices 486371-2020 and 525527-2020 surfaced in Czech-language search).

source_name: SIMAP / TED guidance on European public procurement
why_relevant: Reference layer: thresholds, CPV nomenclature and form structures needed to build correct filters for the Czech tender corpus. Not a data source itself but determines what is capturable.

source_name: ČNB – seznam úspěšně otestovaných zařízení pro zpracování bankovek
why_relevant: Regulatory list of banknote-handling machines (ATMs, recyclers, sorters) that passed ČNB testing. Effectively a vendor/model census of the cash-handling equipment legally usable in CZ – reveals which manufacturers and machine families are deployed, a strong complement to tender documents.

source_name: Registr smluv (smlouvy.gov.cz) – public register of contracts
why_relevant: Statutory register where public bodies must publish the actual signed contracts (including annexes). Card-acquiring contracts and merchant manuals of Czech acquirers are visible in full text there (e.g. acquiring contract annex 'Manuál pro obchodníky' documents). Gives real pricing/fee schedules, terminal counts and service terms that tender notices omit.

source_name: Hlídač státu – tender and contract aggregator with open API
why_relevant: Independent NGO aggregator that indexes the contract register, the public procurement register and ÚOHS decisions into one searchable corpus with a documented API, and links records to companies by IČO. By far the cheapest way to run cross-source keyword monitoring on payment/ATM/cash tenders and to map supplier-buyer relationships.

source_name: Tender Arena – e-procurement platform (Česká pošta, DPP and other profiles)
why_relevant: Hosts the contracting-authority profiles of two of the most relevant non-bank buyers of payment and cash services: Česká pošta s.p. (profile Z0002718, IČ 47114983 – post offices act as a large cash and payment-acceptance network) and Dopravní podnik hl. m. Prahy (profile Z0002394 – contactless fare payment terminals fleet). Tender documents carry site counts and device counts.

source_name: Česká pošta – veřejné zakázky page (procurement entry point)
why_relevant: Official landing page telling which profile/platform Czech Post currently uses (Tender Arena) and listing announced tenders. Czech Post is a state enterprise operating the largest physical cash and bill-payment counter network in CZ (Czech POINT, SIPO, postal money orders), so its tenders are a proxy for retail cash infrastructure demand.

source_name: vhodne-uverejneni.cz – contracting authority profile hosting (incl. ČNB, Česká pošta)
why_relevant: One of the main commercial hosts of statutory contracting-authority profiles; carries ČNB's profile (IČO 48136450, VVZ profile ID 342165) and a Czech Post profile. Useful as an alternative index when an authority migrates platforms and old notices disappear from the current one.

source_name: Správa železnic – veřejné zakázky (E-ZAK instance)
why_relevant: Rail infrastructure manager tenders ticketing/POS and station payment infrastructure; a sectoral contracting authority whose specifications quantify counters, self-service machines and card acceptance requirements at stations.

source_name: ÚOHS – sbírky rozhodnutí (procurement and competition decisions)
why_relevant: Review decisions restate tender parameters in unusual detail when a bid is challenged – e.g. a decision covering a tender for supply, installation and commissioning of 191 self-service contactless fare-payment terminals in trams and buses (Olomouc transport company). ÚOHS also publishes competition-side analyses such as its assessment of ATM-sharing cooperation between Komerční banka, MONETA, Air Bank and UniCredit, which quantifies ATM network rationalisation and urban/rural cash demand.

source_name: Generální ředitelství cel / Celní správa – payment terminal procurement documents
why_relevant: Customs Administration ran a competitive dialogue for nationwide payment terminal operation ('Realizace provozu platebních terminálů pro CS ČR'), and publishes negotiation protocols naming the participating acquirer (ČSOB a.s.). Such documents disclose terminal counts, transaction volumes and commercial terms for a state card-acceptance estate.

source_name: Policie ČR – platby přes platební terminály / acquiring contract annexes
source_subtype: state body operational publication + contract annex
why_relevant: A large state card-acceptance estate (fines paid by card) with published acquiring contract annexes and operating instructions. Combined with the corresponding entry in the contract register it evidences which acquirer serves the state and on what terms – a rare public window on Czech acquiring pricing.
